title.narrative: UNIDO Country programme 2018-2024 to promote inclusive and sustainable industrial development in Venezuela

description.narrative: UNIDO DG and the Vice-president for Economy of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela have signed a Joint Declaration on 27th November of 2017 during the XVII UNIDO General Conference held in Vienna, with the objective of contributing to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the Lima Declaration: towards inclusive and sustainable industrial development. UNIDO will support the government of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela#s efforts in pursuing an economic transformation model to evolve from an oil-based economy to a more diversified economy, through the formulation and development of a Country Programme (CP) that aims at transferring international management and organizational best practices through innovative partnerships for promoting sustainable production, employment and trade to Venezuelan institutions and organizations. The CP will be aligned with the Mixed Economy Model established in the Bolivarian Constitution of Venezuela of 1999 and the #Law of the Plan for the Homeland 2013 # 2019#, which was adopted on 4 December 2013 and is also known as the #Simón Bolívar# National Project, as well as with the ongoing UNDAF 2015-2019.
